title: Processing Purchase Orders

children:
Purchase orders indicate what item(s) your warehouse should be expecting 
 to arrive at the receiving dock. PO's are used by a warehouse's suppliers/vendors 
 to supply receipt information ahead of the arrival of the truck to their 
 warehouse. You can create and manage purchase orders in SCALE on the Purchase 
 Order Insight and Purchase Order Line Insight Screens. For example, suppose your warehouse's supplier is planning on sending 
 you 500 pallets of Item A over the course of a year. They would first 
 create a purchase order for Item A, adding a quantity of 500. When they 
 are ready to ship some of Item A to your warehouse, they would create 
 a shipment associated with this PO, which would indicate how many of the 
 item they are going to send out. When the year is over, and all the Item 
 A quantity has been shipped, the supplier would close the purchase order.
Creating a Purchase Order Header/Detail in SCALE

Creating/Managing Purchase 
 Orders in Trading Partner Management

Purchase orders will only be archived if there are no receipts tied to it. 
 The receipt data archiving master will have to be run (to archive 
 all receipts) for the purchase order archive master to work.

You can use the insight screen to research current purchase order 
 activity.

Access the Purchase 
 Order Insight Screen.

Enter the criteria 
 you want to use to search for purchase order(s).

Select the Include 
 Closed POs toggle to have the system return purchase order records 
 that are closed.

Press the Apply
 Button. The system will display the records in the List Pane.

When a purchase order is closed, you can no longer add any more details 
 to it. To do this, right-click a purchase order and select the Close action. 
 The system will close the purchase order. The purchase order record will 
 disappear from the insight screen grid (unless you had the "Include Closed 
 POs" toggle selected when you performed your previous search query).
Canceling the Close of a Purchase Order...

If you cancel the closing of a purchase order, then you once again will 
 be able to assign receipts to a purchase order. To do this, select 
 a purchase order and choose the Cancel Close action. The system will ask 
 you to confirm your action, and then re-open the purchase order.
